glass.name: Er-Al3-SiO2
glass.description: alumino-silicate, 3.4 mol% Al2O3 (Simpson thesis fibre Al-2), Er as single RE species (stands in for Er/Yb/Tm)

potential.name: Pedone et al. (PMMCS) partial-charge rigid-ion potential
potential.reference: A. Pedone, G. Malavasi, M. C. Menziani, A. N. Cormack, U. Segre, J. Phys. Chem. B 110, 11780-11795 (2006), doi:10.1021/jp0611018
potential.functional_form: U(r)=q_i q_j e^2/r + D_ij[(1-exp(-a_ij(r-r0)))^2-1] + C_ij/r^12 (LAMMPS pair_style pedone)

pairs.Ge-O: not used (no Ge in this glass); amorphouspy lists D=0.158118 a=2.294230 r0=2.261313 C=5.0

potential.parameter_source: All numbers (charges, D, a, r0, C for Si-O, Al-O, Er-O, O-O) were copied from the PMMCS parameter dictionary in amorphouspy v0.8.1 (PyPI wheel amorphouspy-0.8.1-py3-none-any.whl, file amorphouspy/lammps/potentials/pmmcs_potential.py, BAM / A. Atila), which states they are the Pedone 2006 (PMMCS) parameters. The original J. Phys. Chem. B table could not be fetched in this run (ACS paywall/blocked). Si-O, Al-O and O-O agree with the values widely reproduced in the literature; the Er-O row could NOT be independently cross-checked against the original paper or a second reproduction in this run.
potential.electrostatics: coul/dsf (damped shifted force), alpha=0.25 1/A, cutoff 8.0 A (amorphouspy PMMCS default); Morse+C/r^12 cutoff 5.5 A (Pedone 2006)

protocol.ensemble: NVT (fixed box), Nose-Hoover chain, Tdamp 0.1 ps

stages.stage: random placement (min dist O-O 2.2, cation-O 1.5, cation-cation 2.8 A) + CG minimisation
Langevin 3000->6000 K with nve/limit 0.05 A/step (contact relaxation)

protocol.quench_rate_note: 10 K/ps used instead of 5 K/ps: only 2 CPU cores; measured ~7 ms/step per single-core replica (2 replicas run concurrently)
protocol.sampling: 10 frames every 2 ps over the last 20 ps of the 300 K stage
protocol.software: LAMMPS 22 Jul 2025 (PyPI lammps 2025.7.22.4.0), serial per replica

summary.nbo_definition: O bonded to <=1 network former (Si<2.0 A, Al<2.1 A); free O (0 formers) counted as NBO
